title: 首页四章门扉之二·工夫茶席

Natural ground mineral palette: cinnabar vermilion (#824239), azurite mineral blue-green (#536B66), raw ochre (#9A6B46), and delicate gold-leaf hairlines (#C8A464). Fine iron-wire ink linework (铁线描) with weathered mural patina, museum-grade editorial composition, 1:1 square aspect ratio, at least 45% negative parchment space around a single iconic subject, flat diffused archival lighting, strictly no text, no letters, no watermark, no modern UI. Subject: Curatorial chapter emblem for Chaoshan Gongfu Tea: a miniature Mengchen vermilion clay teapot poised over three delicate white porcelain cups arranged in a品-character triangle.
